title: The Archive of the Kuiper Line Anew
author: H. M. Yarrow
blurb: Freya Sterling, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
